topic: Zinnia flowers bloomed on the ISS
hook: Your zinnia flowers once bloomed in space.
title: A Flower Bloomed on the Space Station
description:
In 2016, zinnia flowers bloomed on the ISS. They were grown in a plant chamber, and astronaut Scott Kelly shared the photos. The orange flower in the pictures is real.

#Shorts #Space #ISS
